info.title: SIC Status API v1
info.description: The SIC status API provides information about the current status of the electronic payment services provided by SIX Interbank Clearing Ltd. The information in the status API shows live data.

tags.name: status
tags.description:
**SIC Status**
Information about about the status of various services can be found here.

tags.name: healthcheck
tags.description:
**System Healthcheck**
This allows to check the basic state of the system (can it be reached, does it respond).
